rationale: The agent correctly verified the user (name + zip matched a single account), checked orders via tools, and did not perform any writes without confirmation. It accurately reported that the only delivered order was a digital camera and that the laptop order (#W2417020) was pending, so a return could not be processed. However, the user explicitly requested that if a return wasn’t possible, to see if the order could be canceled. Since the laptop order was shown as pending (which typically allows cancellation under policy), the agent should have proposed cancellation (with explicit confirmation) or at least checked/initiated that path. Instead, the agent only offered escalation to a human without attempting the policy-permitted cancellation. Therefore, the agent did not complete the user’s request in line with policy, leading to a fail verdict. No evidence of fabrication or acting on the wrong account was observed.
